ValidateOffsets() incorrectly allows arrays with length>0 and offset buffer containing only length+offset elements (missing the required +1 sentinel) because it computes required_offsets as (length>0 ? length+offset+1 : 0), which is one too small for subsequent access at index length+offset. This permits out-of-bounds read in BaseListArray::value_offset (array.h:589) during validation.
